pr_title: LE Audio: ASCS release state bug fix
pr_body:
Fixes a bug for the ASCS release state, and updates the BSIM to also test the release procedure. 

Fixes https://github.com/zephyrproject-rtos/zephyr/issues/44621

issue_context.title: ASCS: Sink ASE stuck in Releasing state
issue_context.body:
**Describe the bug**
The Sink ASE stuck in Releasing state. No transition to either Idle or Codec Configured state is made.
Note that CIS has been disconnected already by remote.

**To Reproduce**
* Let remote client to Configure and Start Stream
* Disable ASE as remote client
* Observe ASE state transition to QoS configured state
* Release ASE as remote client
* Observe ASE state transition to Relasing state and no further transition to Idle/Codec Configured state

**Expected behavior**
As per spec:
"If the server accepts the requested Release operation parameter values for an ASE, or the server
autonomously initiates the Release operation for an ASE, the server shall transition the ASE to the
Releasing state and write a value of 0x06 (Releasing) to the ASE_State field."

**Impact**
Remote client cannot use the ASE as only Server can transit ASE from Releasing state.
